build_azure_anthropic_config: build an Azure Anthropic messages configuration class extending AnthropicMessagesConfig with Azure authentication
test_validate_environment: test the validate_anthropic_messages_environment method to set up Azure authentication headers for the /v1/messages endpoint
build_complete_url: build the complete Azure Anthropic /v1/messages URL from a base endpoint with automatic path normalization

transform_request: transform an Anthropic messages request by applying Azure-specific modifications like removing unsupported cache_control scope
